title: 초보자를 위한 반려 앵무새 기르기 안내서
fullPassage: Thinking about getting a parrot? Great choice! Parrots are smart, social birds — but keep in mind that they need proper care to stay healthy and happy. Housing: Use a cage that is at least 36 inches wide. This allows your parrot to stretch and move freely. Diet: Feed your parrot seeds, fruits, and vegetables. Avoid chocolate, avocado, and salty foods. Vet Care: Visit an avian vet once a year. Go sooner if your parrot shows any signs of illness. Grooming: Trim your parrot's nails if they grow longer than half an inch. Sleeping: Make sure your parrot gets 10 to 12 hours each night. Purchasing: Ask a trusted breeder for advice. Parrot prices can vary, but they often depend on the bird's age.
